basis: Percentages as issuer disclosures, rounded and methodology dependent; product groups are not reportable segments. No invented continuous organic series.
sources: Annual reports Revenue/Product disaggregation; 2017–2018 also FY2019 comparative. 2016 detail not safely extracted; null is not zero.
reclassifications: FY2019 introduced two segments: Semiconductor & System Design and Software Integrity, with FY2017–2018 recast comparatives. FY2018 and earlier originally had one reportable segment; this does not imply there was no Software Integrity business.
FY2023 product taxonomy changed from IP & System Integration to Design IP; FY2022 EDA recast62.9%, DesignIP25.9%, Software9.2%,Other2%. The old EDA50.8% is not comparable.
FY2024 discontinued Software Integrity; FY2023 continuing EDA69.2%,IP29%,Other1.8%, FY2022 continuing EDA69.2%,IP28.5%,Other2.3%.
FY2025 Ansys included July17 onward; Q325 initial S&A excluded semiconductor analysis formerly in EDA, subsequently Ansys group includes all acquired portfolio.

FY2027 official Investor Day deck reclassifies Ansys semiconductor unit and Other into EDA, residual Ansys into S&A; reportable segments remain Design Automation and Design IP. Need recast comparatives before growth attribution.

latest_q3_2026.recurring_definition: Time-based products, multi-period IP contracts, maintenance and services recognized over time. Not ARR. No defensible consolidated ARR disclosed in reviewed primary materials.

2026_channel_accounting.treatment: Gross presentation changes revenue/margin ratios; do not call it organic value creation.
